title: docs(spec): tenancy-posture prose says which side of the open/commercial split gates activation
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RGv5iq3ShhcQehne7GnJDs)_
Fixes #29318

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 `tenancy-posture.ts` 的两段注释（文件头「开源代码与激活授权」一节、`postureStampsOrganization` 的说明），外加一个 spec patch changeset；无代码、无 schema、无生成物变化。
- 为什么改：原文「open code does not mean free activation」没说是哪一侧，读起来像开源安装也要许可证；按 ADR-0132，开源安装挂上 `@objectstack/organizations` 即可启用 group/isolated，只有商业侧子类才加许可证门。
- 风险与回滚：纯注释，零运行时风险；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts` 第 23–48 行（文件头一节）与 `postureStampsOrganization` 的说明块。
- 两分钟验证：`git diff origin/main -- packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts`，预期只见注释行变化，且每句激活相关的话都写明是开源侧还是商业侧。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Header section** (was "Open code, entitled activation", now "Open code; activation is entitled only on a commercial host"). It keeps the implementation-vs-entitlement separation and now says which side each sentence describes:
  - On an open install, activation is gate-free: the open runtime carries no licence check (ADR-0132 D2) and entitles both walled postures by construction (ADR-0132 D4), so mounting it is enough. Measured on `origin/main`: `packages/plugins/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts` declares `supportedPostures = ['group', 'isolated']` with the "NO LICENCE GATE HERE" note beside it.
  - On a commercial host, activation is entitled: the package of the same name subclasses the open one and answers its licence gate in its own constructor, and the host's manifest resolves the name to it (ADR-0132 D2, D3). "Open code does not mean free activation" is kept, scoped to that side, matching the ADR-0105 D12 amendment's "on the commercial side".
- **Cloud ADR-0016 铁律 paragraph.** The guarantee no longer rests on "not giving the posture away". It now says the iron rule is satisfied by the wall itself on both sides: a multi-org shape never runs unwalled (ADR-0093 D5). Whether switching the posture on is free is the entitlement question, not the iron rule's. The Chinese quotation (强制免费、治理收费) is unchanged.
- **`postureStampsOrganization` docblock.** "Open code does not mean free activation" is now scoped the same way: mounting the runtime is enough on an open install, and only a commercial host gates activation.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/29318-tenancy-posture-activation-prose.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch (the docblocks ship in the published `.d.ts`).

No forced test edits.

## Tests

Comment-only diff. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date (the file has no `.describe()`, so nothing generated moves). Spec `typecheck` and `test` were run locally (readings under Verification).

## Acceptance notes

- The `OrgScopingEntitlement` docblock further down already scopes its "packaging decision" sentence to the commercial runtime and names ADR-0132 D4 for the open package, so it is left as it is.
